items.stem: For the functions f(t)=t^2-4t+1 and g(x)=3x-2, if f(g(x))=-3, what is the value of x?
items.explanation: Substitute g(x) into f: f(g(x))=(3x-2)^2-4(3x-2)+1. Setting this equal to -3 gives (3x-2)^2-4(3x-2)+4=0, or (3x-4)^2=0. Therefore, x=4/3.

items.stem: Let f(x) = 3x - 4 and g(x) = 2x + 5. What is the value of f^(-1)(g^(-1)(33))?
